rationale.consistency: Mirrors trimPathPrefix's structure, index naming, url.PathUnescape use, EqualFold comparison, and even its error/comment phrasing.
rationale.edge_cases: Traced: decoded-vs-%2F, %62 mid-token, escaped pattern vs plain path, empty/overlong suffix, hex-case all behave per spec; literal '%' patterns handled sensibly.
rationale.scope: Only touches the suffix call site and replaces the now-dead reverse helper; prefix, query and other ops untouched.
rationale.readability: Clear lock-step loop with descriptive booleans; the header comment is a bit long but usefully explains why reverse-then-prefix fails.
rationale.robustness: All slicing guarded by iPath>=3 / iSuffix>=3 checks; decode failure falls back to unchanged path like the prefix code.
rationale.maintainability: Some structural duplication with trimPathPrefix, but the two are symmetric and independently understandable; no hidden coupling.
